name: Cupid Ltd
description: Makes condoms, lubricants, IVD test kits and now perfumes and deodorants; sells in India and abroad
why: The business is excellent: sales up 158% and profit up 193% year on year, ROE 28%, almost no debt, and guidance raised in September. The chart is still an uptrend that has been consolidating for five weeks. The conflict is price: ~330x trailing and ~183x this year's guided profit, against an industry P/E of 36. Fundamentals plus an uptrend would normally mean Accumulate (small); overridden to Hold because results land on 11 Nov and the stock is already slightly over the 15% cap.
what_to_do: Do nothing before results: keep all 50 shares, don't add. After results, sell 25 shares (~₹8,570) if Q2 revenue is under ₹200 Cr, FY27 guidance is cut, or it closes below ₹278 two days running. No trim just for the cap: December's ₹25k takes it to ~13%.
watch: Q2 results: revenue ≥₹200 Cr and ₹800 Cr FY27 guidance kept. Also whether receivables shrink.
confidence_note: Q2 results in 2 days will change the fundamentals; pledge, interest cover and 5-yr P/E weren't available.

market.exposure: Flat today, in line with the market. Low beta (0.58). Oil-linked inputs mean a mild cost headwind if crude stays high; a richly valued small-cap gets hit in any risk-off.
market.plain: After last week's big rally the market is taking a breather, and oil is creeping back up near $98. Cupid moved flat with the market.

Board meeting on 11 Nov to approve Q2 results

going_right: Sales roughly 2.5x a year ago; profit nearly 3x
Management raised its yearly target in September
New deal to sell in 425+ V2 Retail stores
Owners keep buying more shares; big funds starting to buy
to_watch: Priced far above other consumer companies; any slip can hit hard
Customers pay slowly, so profit isn't fully turning into cash
Results on Wed 11 Nov could move it 10%+ either way
Already up about 6x in a year
